name: Qibla Courtyard
summary: A terraced mosque courtyard turns into a compact axonometric mark, with a Qibla marker held inside its open court.
why: The courtyard uses a consistent two-to-one projection, and the minaret sits physically in its rear-left wall. Its front doorway follows the same projected foundation. The centered Qibla marker uses the courtyard axis and generous negative space rather than a separate corner badge.
risk: The projected court is more architectural and less immediately familiar than a front-facing mosque. The marker expresses intention rather than an actual compass bearing.
reasonToChoose: You want a distinctive architectural view with direction built into the courtyard.
